drafted_from: tool:check-a-public-address's own row (its words, input schema and invoke) and do-work/check-a-public-address.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check that the public page at this address shows the words I expect and answers status 200." It asks the address through the public-address guard and answers ok, the status, the body size, a text excerpt, and the list of expectations that did not hold.
no_lists_because: It keeps no row: it asks one address and returns the judgement; the caller decides what to do with it.
instructions: 1. Give it one public HTTPS address; a private, loopback or link-local address is refused before any connection.
2. Add the expectations you need: status, contains (words that must appear in the body), and json_path with equals for a value in a JSON answer.
3. Read ok and failed: ok is true when nothing failed; failed names each expectation that did not hold (status, contains:<word>, json_path, equals, or request when the address could not be asked).

worked_examples.title: A page must show its marker and answer 200
worked_examples.ask: Check that the public page at this address answers 200 and contains the marker words.
worked_examples.given: A public page that answers 200 with a JSON-LD block.
